unit_policy: Every limit declares an unambiguous unit and absolute hard maximum.
rules: A configurable value never removes the absolute hard maximum.
Parsing and allocation checks occur before untrusted-size allocation.
Compression entries include compressed size, decompressed size and ratio limits.
Every externally controlled count, depth, length or byte size is registered before implementation acceptance.
Unknown or absent required limits fail the owning contract review; they are not inferred at runtime.

entries.resource: One post-TLS length-prefixed encoded WireEnvelope
entries.allocation_impact: Validate uint32_be length before allocating or reading the frame payload; never reserve from an unchecked peer length.
boundary_tests: 1,048,576 bytes accepted when message-specific limits also permit
entries.notes: The four-byte prefix is excluded from payload_length.

entries.resource: Encoded ClientBootstrap or ClientResume protobuf payload
entries.allocation_impact: Bound total payload and nested byte fields before retaining or performing credential work.
boundary_tests: 65,536 bytes accepted if all field limits pass
oversized unknown fields cannot bypass the total bound

entries.resource: ClientBootstrap.admission_material
entries.allocation_impact: Reject peer-controlled length before copying or verification.
entries.notes: FND-04 may define a smaller semantic credential format, but FND-02 decoders remain required to safely reject/handle up to this hard wire maximum.

entries.resource: ClientResume.reconnect_material
entries.allocation_impact: Reject peer-controlled length before copying or verification.

entries.resource: UTF-8 client_build_id
entries.allocation_impact: Validate UTF-8 and byte length before retaining or logging.

entries.resource: supported_capability_id or selected_capability_id collection
entries.allocation_impact: Bound repeated field count before sorting, uniqueness checks or set intersection.
boundary_tests: duplicates or unsorted IDs rejected as INVALID_CAPABILITY_SET
entries.notes: Core v1 behavior is not capability-optional; this fixed decoder bound protects future additive extensions.

entries.resource: Foundation protobuf repeated field without a smaller named limit
entries.allocation_impact: Bound collection growth before materializing peer-controlled repeated values.

entries.resource: Decoded protobuf message nesting
entries.allocation_impact: Decoder must enforce recursion/nesting depth without stack or heap blowup.

entries.resource: ClientCommand.expected_revision
entries.allocation_impact: Bound revision vector before command normalization.

entries.resource: ClientCommand.payload
entries.allocation_impact: Reject before command-specific decode/allocation or domain mutation.
boundary_tests: 65,536 accepted when the command-type limit permits

entries.resource: CommandResult.payload
entries.allocation_impact: Bound before result-specific decode/allocation.
boundary_tests: 65,536 accepted when the command-type limit permits

entries.resource: Contiguous commands sent but not terminally acknowledged for one GameSession
entries.allocation_impact: Ingress accounting rejects excess new work before adding it to session/runtime queues.
boundary_tests: 64 outstanding commands accepted subject to runtime capacity
retry of an already-counted CommandId does not consume another slot

entries.resource: State domains in one ResyncRequest or SnapshotBody
entries.allocation_impact: Bound domain vectors/maps before construction.

entries.resource: StateDelta.payload
entries.allocation_impact: Reject before domain-specific delta decode/allocation.
boundary_tests: 262,144 accepted when the domain-specific limit permits

entries.resource: Chunks in one SnapshotBody transfer
entries.allocation_impact: Validate SnapshotBegin before allocating chunk tracking structures.

entries.resource: SnapshotChunk.data
entries.allocation_impact: Validate chunk length before retaining or copying.

entries.resource: Complete encoded SnapshotBody before protobuf decode
entries.allocation_impact: Track cumulative received bytes using checked arithmetic and abort before exceeding the bound.
boundary_tests: integer overflow in cumulative accounting rejected

entries.resource: One encoded game EventEnvelope including payload
entries.allocation_impact: Check encoded record length before retaining, decoding, batching or publishing; family-specific maxima may be lower.
boundary_tests: 262,144-byte envelope accepted only when every nested limit passes

entries.resource: EventEnvelope.payload registered protobuf bytes
entries.allocation_impact: Reject payload length before family-specific decode or copy; total envelope limit also applies.
boundary_tests: 196,608-byte payload accepted if total envelope remains within bound
payload cannot bypass total envelope bound

entries.resource: One retention profile, identity-domain, build or revision string in EventEnvelope
entries.allocation_impact: Validate per-string length and profile-specific ASCII grammar before retaining, indexing or logging.
boundary_tests: 128-byte allowed canonical string accepted where field grammar permits

entries.resource: Decoded event envelope and registered payload protobuf nesting
entries.allocation_impact: Decoder enforces recursion depth before stack/heap amplification.
boundary_tests: one level above configured/hard maximum rejected deterministically

entries.resource: In-process queued best-effort gameplay telemetry events per collector
entries.allocation_impact: Reserve bounded collector accounting before enqueue. Overflow follows counted best-effort drop policy and never blocks authoritative gameplay on remote analytics storage.
boundary_tests: next new best-effort event counted/dropped when full
durable audit cannot be routed into this drop queue

entries.resource: Total retained encoded bytes in one in-process best-effort telemetry collector queue
entries.allocation_impact: Checked cumulative byte accounting must reject/drop before queue growth exceeds the configured or absolute limit.
boundary_tests: byte ceiling may bind before entry ceiling

entries.resource: Events in one publication/delivery batch
entries.allocation_impact: Split larger committed backlogs into bounded batches; never discard durable records to meet batch size.
boundary_tests: 1,024 events accepted subject to byte bound
durable records remain recoverable after split

entries.resource: Total encoded bytes in one publication/delivery batch
entries.allocation_impact: Use checked cumulative accounting and split before 8 MiB. Individual event maxima still apply.
boundary_tests: 8 MiB batch accepted only if event-count limit passes
one byte over requires split/reject before send

entries.resource: Events materialized in one dead-letter/quarantine operator/reprocessing batch
entries.allocation_impact: Bound one in-memory/transfer batch. Durable quarantine storage itself is not deleted at this bound.
boundary_tests: 4,096 materialized entries accepted subject to bytes
paging does not discard durable quarantine evidence

entries.resource: Encoded bytes materialized in one dead-letter/quarantine batch
entries.allocation_impact: Page/split operator/reprocessing transfer before 32 MiB without deleting durable source evidence.
boundary_tests: 32 MiB accepted subject to entry/event bounds

entries.resource: Events decoded/applied to a derived consumer in one replay batch
entries.allocation_impact: Bound replay work per batch and preserve checkpoint/cancellation between batches.
boundary_tests: 4,096 events accepted subject to byte bound
batch replay never invokes gameplay mutation

entries.resource: Total encoded event bytes in one replay batch
entries.allocation_impact: Use checked byte accounting and split before 32 MiB.
boundary_tests: 32 MiB accepted only with count/event limits

entries.resource: Maximum events requested in one bounded replay job/window before explicit continuation
entries.allocation_impact: Larger rebuilds must be partitioned into explicit resumable windows; do not allocate tracking for an unbounded caller range.
boundary_tests: 100,000-event window accepted as a bounded job

entries.resource: Rows/events returned in one investigation/analytics query page
entries.allocation_impact: Require pagination/cursor before materializing a larger result set.
boundary_tests: 10,000 rows accepted subject to byte/access policy

entries.resource: Encoded bytes returned/materialized in one analytics/investigation query page
entries.allocation_impact: Stream/page before 64 MiB and apply access/redaction before serialization.
boundary_tests: 64 MiB accepted subject to row/access limits
redaction cannot be bypassed by pagination

entries.resource: One generated investigation/export evidence package
entries.allocation_impact: Package generation must stream/chunk or explicitly split before 256 MiB; privacy/export authorization is checked before inclusion.
boundary_tests: 256 MiB maximum package generated only for authorized data
one byte over requires split/new package
split packages retain manifest/correlation without leaking unauthorized records

entries.resource: One native Game to Platform catalog input or output snapshot file
entries.allocation_impact: Check file size before full read/JSON parse and check output bytes before publication.
boundary_tests: 268,435,456-byte file may proceed to other validation
output over hard maximum rejected before final publication

entries.resource: Capability manifest or required-capability collection entries
entries.allocation_impact: Bound capability collections before sorting, uniqueness and compatibility checks.

entries.resource: Entity records in one native catalog snapshot
entries.allocation_impact: Reject entity count before uniqueness sorting or projection work exceeds the fixed v1 ceiling.

entries.resource: Relation records in one native catalog snapshot
entries.allocation_impact: Reject relation count before endpoint validation or canonical sorting exceeds the fixed v1 ceiling.

entries.resource: Authoritative tombstone records in one native catalog snapshot
entries.allocation_impact: Bound tombstones before contradiction/completeness checks and canonical sorting.
boundary_tests: 200,000 tombstones accepted only for complete supported capabilities

entries.resource: One UTF-8 string or object key in the schema-v1 envelope/record data
entries.allocation_impact: Measure encoded UTF-8 bytes before retaining, sorting or emitting the string.
boundary_tests: 2,048 UTF-8 bytes accepted where grammar permits

entries.resource: Nested JSON depth inside entity/relation data
entries.allocation_impact: Reject before recursion exceeds the fixed v1 semantic-data depth.

entries.resource: Members in one nested entity/relation data object
entries.allocation_impact: Bound object members before recursive validation and canonical serialization.

entries.resource: Entries in one nested entity/relation data array
entries.allocation_impact: Bound nested arrays before recursive validation and canonical serialization.
boundary_tests: 200,000 nested entries accepted when otherwise valid
